INV-3.verify: docs/migration/decisions/0014-scripting-plugin-runtime-strategy.md is status 'decided' (2026-08-23), so INV-3's precondition is met and this is checkable now, not deferred. Verified: (1) the 5 new deny-set entries ({[:os,:time]}, {[:os,:date]}, {[:os,:clock]}, {[:os,:difftime]}, {[:os,:setlocale]}) are appended as literal tuples inside the single @sandbox_deny_set module attribute (sandbox.ex lines ~132-230+); (2) Sandbox.new/1 maps @sandbox_deny_set (one list, now 33 entries, confirmed by `grep -c '^    {\[' sandbox.ex` = 33) into sandboxed_paths and passes that single list to Lua.new(sandboxed: sandboxed_paths) -- no second/partial list is constructed anywhere, so the ':sandboxed-replaces-defaults trap' the moduledoc warns about is genuinely avoided: this is additive, not replacing. (3) platform.now is the only new host capability introduced; Platform.install/1 wires only `platform.now` at Lua path [:platform, :now] via Lua.set!/3 and never touches the deny-set (confirmed by reading install/1's body -- single Lua.set! call, no interaction with @sandbox_deny_set or sandboxed_paths). (4) Platform.now/0's call chain is: Application.get_env(:letflow, :lua_platform_time_source, SystemClock) -> source.now() -> DateTime.shift_zone!/2 -> DateTime.to_iso8601/1. The TimeSource behaviour has exactly one callback, now/0 -> DateTime.t(), with no arguments through which a script could pass a path, URL, command, or other capability-relevant input -- there is no parameter surface for a script to influence. SystemClock.now/0 calls only DateTime.utc_now/0 (no file, network, process, or port access). No other TimeSource implementation exists in lib/ (grep confirms zero other @behaviour TimeSource modules under lib/). (5) Resolution of which module loads is config/application-env only: config/config.exs statically sets Letflow.Engine.Lua.Platform.SystemClock at compile/boot time; grep across lib/, config/, test/ for 'lua_platform_time_source' shows writers are only config/config.exs (static) and test setup/on_exit via Application.put_env (test-only, not reachable from any tenant-facing request path or from Lua script text itself -- no Lua-exposed function reads or writes this key). No tenant/user input reaches Application.get_env's key or default resolution. Conclusion: platform.now is a pure, ungated time read matching decision 0014's capability-matrix classification ('positive design statement, not an omission'); no capability beyond a time read is reachable through this path. PASS.
